findings.claim: Checkpoint B 的限域 capacity pytest 在 card source 上失敗，授權前 regression gate 不可宣告 READY。
findings.evidence: 命令 `uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_pantheon_writer_vnext_runtime_activation_readiness.py tests/test_pantheon_writer_vnext_runtime_activation_e2e.py tests/test_pantheon_writer_vnext_runtime_activation_capacity.py -q -p no:cacheprovider` 結果為 1 failed, 12 passed；失敗 assertion 為 `assert len(calls) == 1`，實際 `len(calls) == 0`。
findings.reproduction: 在 card source `4467df070a74a7f91c18176fd26e8d5264e85182` 執行同一 pytest 命令。

findings.claim: RA005 raw capacity source retains local root provenance fields, but repo package normalization removes them before Checkpoint B boundary.
findings.evidence: Raw RA005 path audit found local root provenance in source measurement artifacts. `package/capacity-proof-normalized.json` omits cycle `root`, package path audit has no local absolute path matches, and package manifest remains package-relative.
findings.reproduction: Scan raw RA005 artifacts and compare them with `ra_checkpoint_b_assessment/package/capacity-proof-normalized.json`.
